summary: Tested custom QR poster copy, CA/TX/FL renewal overlays, checklist persistence, Delivery Retry, and core regressions against the public preview URL. Backend feature/regression tests passed. Fixed a blocking undefined-state crash in the Intake share dialog and reverified poster download end to end. One Settings UI condition remains: the STATE-SPECIFIC badge is hidden while the customized checklist is locked.

ui_bugs.issue: checklist-state-badge is rendered only when checklist.unlocked is true. With the admin at California and 45 days remaining, the API returns state_customized=true but the required STATE-SPECIFIC badge is absent from the locked card header. The badge appears after temporarily unlocking at 25 days.

action_items: Render checklist-state-badge whenever checklist.state_customized is true, not only inside the checklist.unlocked progress block; preserve its right-side header placement for both locked and unlocked cards.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx lines 243-255 nest the state badge under checklist.unlocked, which conflicts with the state_customized display requirement.

Intakes.jsx referenced posterHeadline/posterNote setters and values without declaring state, causing a ReferenceError whenever the share dialog opened; two missing useState declarations were added and the complete encoded PDF download flow now passes.

success_rate.backend: 100% for scoped feature and regression cases (8/8 final selected cases passed)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (all tested flows passed after the Intake crash fix except the locked-card badge condition)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary intakes and journal entries, plus deterministic sent/failed history rows; all were removed. Temporarily changed admin state/expiration and restored state=California, commission_expires=2026-09-14 (45 days), with original checklist progress preserved. One real certificate email was sent to the admin; failed-provider attempts delivered no email.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend poster tests validate both/default/individual/empty/HTML-character cases through PyMuPDF. State tests cover full names and CA/TX/FL abbreviations, exact spot-check titles, stable IDs, unsupported New York generic copy, and toggle persistence across state changes. UI verifies poster max lengths and encoded request URL, unlocked California badge/title/pill/generic item, failed-only Resend with recipient prefill, intake-to-Journal prefill, dashboard/login/logout, and cleanup. The known pre-existing ingress brute-force behavior and wildcard CORS were excluded per request.
rca_of_the_issue: The remaining badge defect is caused by placing the checklist.state_customized badge inside the checklist.unlocked conditional. The fixed Intake crash was caused by JSX using posterHeadline, posterNote, setPosterHeadline, and setPosterNote without corresponding useState declarations.
